Arne, Baran and Citronimus remained near Greyfen Ruins after their discoveries beneath the old chapel. Before leaving, they returned to Lysa Marr to ask whether she knew anything more about the Ashen Ledger.
Lysa said she had heard the name once before. Several months earlier, Elira Voss had mentioned that the Pale Wardens were searching for records connected to old smuggling routes between Greyfen and Blackbridge. Lysa did not know whether the Ashen Ledger was one of those records.
Lysa also clarified that she works alongside the Pale Wardens when travellers need medical help, but she has never formally joined the organization. Elira Voss remains one of her closest friends.
While travelling west from Greyfen Chapel, the group encountered Orren Hale, a former scout who once served under Captain Edric Vane. Orren left Vane's service two years ago and now works independently as a guide.
Orren recognized the name Toren Vale. He said Toren had passed through Greyfen during the previous winter and had asked questions about routes leading toward Stonecross. Orren did not know why.
According to Orren, Captain Edric Vane still commands the Blackbridge militia, although Orren believes Vane has become increasingly secretive. Orren had heard rumours that Vane was dealing with smugglers, but he had no proof and did not know whether the Ashen Hand was involved.
Near the northern road the group found an abandoned supply cart. Inside was a sealed wooden case bearing the mark of the Order of the Silver Lantern. The case contained several ordinary travelling supplies and a damaged document titled The Greyfen Register.
The Greyfen Register listed deliveries between Stonecross, Blackbridge and several smaller settlements. One entry mentioned the Fox and Lantern Inn, but nothing in the document proved that Mara Venn had been involved in any wrongdoing.
The final pages had been torn out.
Baran suggested taking the register back to Gunther. Arne wanted to continue toward Blackbridge immediately, while Citronimus argued that they should first return to Stonecross and ask Mara Venn what she knew about the deliveries.
The group decided to keep the Greyfen Register and travel toward Stonecross.
